name: refgraph
description: Visualize symbol references as a force-directed graph and a file-coupling chord diagram

refgraph.binaryPath.description: Path to a custom refgraph executable. Leave empty to use the scanner bundled with the extension. Relative paths are resolved against the workspace folder, then PATH.

refgraph.directory.description: Directory to scan, relative to the workspace folder.

refgraph.filesPattern.description: Regular expression a file's path (relative to the scan directory, with / separators) must match to be scanned. JavaScript syntax and case-insensitive, like the VS Code search box; unanchored, so use ^ and $ to pin it. Empty scans every file. Example: \.(c|cc|cpp|h|hpp)$

refgraph.identifier.description: Declaration keyword to look for (e.g. struct, class).

refgraph.separator.description: Separator between the keyword and the symbol name.

scripts.vscode:prepublish: npm run compile && npm run build:scanner
